dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Please, it wasn't me! On my life, I didn't drink the most...

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: —But you still got hammered, didn't you? 20 laps, not one less! Keep at it 'til you can take on anything even when you're as drunk as a skunk!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Ho, you two! You're both thinking, "Seems like I got off light this time," aren't ya? Saw you two staggering about earlier, didn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Twenty sets of strength drills with Anselm! And not a sip of booze 'til you're done!
